caption: The drawing features a single, centrally placed geometric object composed of brown tones. The object consists of a horizontal, elongated rectangular frame with rounded corners and two open rectangular slots running parallel within it. Inside the left slot and positioned at the center is a sphere, also shaded brown. The rectangular frame sits atop a vertical, elongated, brown stem that extends downward from the bottom edge of the rectangle. The background is plain and off-white, with the artist's name, "DANA BARTLETT," inscribed in small capital letters in the lower right quadrant of the image in brown ink. There are no other objects or additional colors present in the drawing.
title: Rattle
